title: Launch orchestration for Private/VPC/on-prem: RBAC, Audit Logs, KMS
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Coordinate cross-functional launch of Private/VPC/on-prem feature set that includes RBAC (role-based access control), tenant-scoped audit logging, and KMS integration for encryption-at-rest. Scope covers release notes, customer enablement material, sales enablement, support runbooks, and staged rollout policy for early access customers. Out-of-scope: on-prem installer packaging iterations (tracked in ENG-3120).
decision_log: 2026-02-26: Chosen RBAC model = role + resource-scope (org, project, host) after security guild review.
2026-03-02: Audit logs will be exported in JSONL to customer-specified S3/GCS destinations and stored encrypted at rest by default.
2026-03-07: KMS integration will support AWS KMS and customer BYOK via HSM in a follow-up phase; initial launch supports AWS KMS and GCP KMS.
2026-03-10: Canary rollout strategy approved: 5 pilot customers -> 25 customers -> open GA, with automatic rollback triggers on error rates and latency regressions.

release_notes_draft: Private Deployments: RBAC, Audit Logs, KMS support (private-2026.04) - Summary: Customers deploying Redwood in Private/VPC/on-prem environments can now configure fine-grained RBAC, route immutable audit logs to customer sinks, and integrate with cloud KMS providers for encryption key management. Migration notes: existing private tenants will have a recommended migration checklist; customers using legacy tokens must rotate credentials to align with RBAC roles. Links: migration guide, admin console screenshots, troubleshooting doc.

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: RBAC misconfiguration could block admin access for customers. Mitigation: provide one-click emergency org-owner recovery and require an override approval flow for first 24h of pilot.
Risk: Performance regression due to audit-log write amplification. Mitigation: throttle and batch writes; monitor token latency SLOs, implement fallback to buffered local store if sink unavailable.
Risk: Incomplete KMS coverage for on-prem HSMs. Mitigation: clearly document supported KMS providers for GA and set expectation for BYOK/HSM beta.
Risk: Legal/compliance delays on regional data residency language. Mitigation: Legal reviewed copy is required before GA; postpone region-specific marketing until sign-off.
Risk: Support volume spike post-GA. Mitigation: prepare runbooks and a dedicated on-call window staffed by platform engineers for first 72h.
acceptance_criteria: RBAC: Create/read/update/delete roles in Admin console, assign to users and service accounts, enforce at API level in staging.
Audit Logs: Customer can configure an S3/GCS sink and validate delivery of JSONL events for a 72h test window.
KMS: Customer can register cloud KMS (AWS/GCP) and perform a test encrypt/decrypt cycle from control plane.
Docs: Admin guide, migration checklist, API reference, and troubleshooting published and reviewed by Support and Security.
GTM: Sales enablement completed; at least 3 deal teams trained and demo recording published.
Security sign-off: Compliance checklist signed by Omar Khan and Legal acknowledgement obtained.
